commands.summary: Create audio from text to speech (beta).
commands.description: Render text to speech into a new library asset. Without --credential, Polymorfa's managed key for the provider is used; with it, your stored provider credential for the same provider. Text is 1 to 5000 characters (4096 for openai). OpenAI voices: alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, fable, nova, onyx, sage, shimmer, verse. ElevenLabs takes a voice ID. Models: elevenlabs eleven_multilingual_v2 (default), eleven_flash_v2_5, eleven_turbo_v2_5; openai gpt-4o-mini-tts (default), tts-1, tts-1-hd. Requires a server API key with voice:manage. Voice Automation is a beta (calls.voice-automation) for enrolled teams only; other teams get voice_not_enabled (exit code 6).

commands.summary: Store a provider key (beta).
commands.description: Store your own ElevenLabs or OpenAI key for text to speech. The key is read from the environment variable named by --key-env (default POLYMORFA_VOICE_PROVIDER_KEY) or, when that is unset, from standard input; never from an argument. The provider checks the key first; a rejected key fails with provider_credential_invalid (exit code 2). Only the key's fingerprint is ever shown. With --project the credential belongs to that project; without it, every project of the team can use it. Requires a server API key with voice:manage. Voice Automation is a beta (calls.voice-automation) for enrolled teams only; other teams get voice_not_enabled (exit code 6).
